title: Build AI-Powered Website with Claude Code + n8n Lead Automation, AI Chatbot & Email Follow-Ups
systemName: Your Claude Code website and n8n lead system

facts: Saved-jobs batch 2026-10-26, job 1. Post fetched read-only 3:09 PM CT (ACTIVE, can_apply true, 0 hired).

Post asks for: Claude Code built Next.js site (4 to 5 pages, lead form, AI chat widget, basic SEO, deployed), n8n lead capture from website plus Facebook/Instagram Lead Ads and DMs with dedupe into Sheets/Airtable/CRM and instant team alert, Claude chatbot trained on services/pricing/FAQs that qualifies and hands to a human, Day 0/2/5 AI-written email follow-up that stops on reply or booking, error alerts.
No client name, business name or industry stated in the post. Personalization omitted (U-006 fallback: your team).
Meta (Facebook/Instagram) has no supported adapter, so it is described as an entry point, not shown as a native screen. Chat transcript and result shown on the custom workbench.
